method: Digest-bound original ELF disassembly and static dataflow inspection; no native execution or emulation.
limitations: Prior2568 binds RPC store owners and initialization; prior2523 covers read-side materialization. New scope is successful occupied/vacant mutation plus FIFO queue drain, not full RPC reconstruction.
Valid exact32-byte keyed maps and successful tree conversion/insertion/removal/growth are premises. Their balancing, memory allocation, payload destructor internals and concurrency remain unclosed.
Occupied update does not append or promote; vacancy appends; while queue length exceeds descriptor+40 popfront and remove exactkey. No read endpoint behavior inferred.

Source uses owned standard maps/queues and opaque payloads; static native refcount/copy handoffs are documented without claiming identical allocator or destructor behavior. No captured code executed or emulated; all gatesfalse.
